sloka: एवम् उक्{]तः ततो देवैः देवेश्वरः प्रभुः ।प्रादुर् आसीत् ततो अत्र एव शंख चक्र धरो हरिः ॥१-४५-२२॥
transliteration: evam uk{]taḥ tato devaiḥ deveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।prādur āsīt tato atra eva śaṁkha cakra dharo hariḥ ॥1-45-22॥

translations.english: Thereupon, Hari the Lord of celestial beings extolled by the devatas appeared bearing the conch and discus.
